notes.title: Version Update Notice V0.6.1｜0923
notes.notes: [p]Commanders,[/p][p]Thank you for your feedback today regarding the abnormal behavior of the Mother Rat in the "Monster Defense Operation III" level of the Belhaven Chapter. The fix has been completed and deployed. This issue was primarily caused by a critical problem that occurred during the development of buffs related to Chapter III, which resulted in the Mother Rat not exiting as designed, thereby affecting the normal progression of the level. The issue has now been resolved, and the level can be completed normally.[/p][p]We sincerely apologize for the impact this issue has caused. We have strengthened inspection and testing within our development process to prevent similar situations from recurring.[/p][p]Thank you for your understanding and support![/p]

notes.title: Version Major Update Notice V0.6.0 | 0922
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416335/ec219c7b7486d7a689dd3293178d6228a1155b41.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Commanders, thank you for your patience![/b] Today, we are officially launching the [b]v0.6 Major Update — \[Chapter III: Into the Death Ring][/b].[/p][p]This update brings:[/p][list][*][p][b]New Chapter[/b]: Primal Death Ring[/p][/*][*][p][b]New System[/b]: Mecha Paint Customization[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Mecha[/b]: Antey from [i]Siberia Manufacturing Group[/i][/p][/*][*][p]A set of brand-new modules and loadouts[/p][/*][/list][p]It’s another all-nighter editing trailer — check them out![/p][previewyoutube="ZmOHdkLHQFk;full"][/previewyoutube][h3]New Map Mechanics[/h3][p]According to reports from the Association’s advance team, the Primal Death Ring contains multiple extreme environments. In the \[Frozen Zone], blizzards erode every challenger that dares to step in, while the Cryo condition makes Mecha movement sluggish. Commanders must direct their squad with extra caution.[/p][p][img src="https://t18q1u0b4vq.feishu.cn/space/api/box/stream/download/asynccode/?code=ZGFmODUxNTkwZmU5YTNiMWIxM2IzMDQwYzNkODNjMzZfSDJyR3J3ZUpucHVFcjN3VXlaTncwWGtYT3p3VVpqb1JfVG9rZW46UzJnVWI3SU9kb2xyVlh4NmFzUmNidGpXbkNlXzE3NTg1MjM5NTU6MTc1ODUyNzU1NV9WNA"][/img][/p][p]In the \[Scorched Zone], rivers of lava devour anything that trespasses. Mecha must constantly avoid molten flows, descent of fire, and heatwaves that render armor and shields useless.[/p][p][img src="https://t18q1u0b4vq.feishu.cn/space/api/box/stream/download/asynccode/?code=ZGEzMGQyZjM4MWRiMzVjOGY4ODRhZmEwYTU2MjUxMTZfaVVMNVhQekp6aXYxb1U4SnBiZGM4OHF0QWZFOTBZNHdfVG9rZW46UHdQcGJCOUJSb2w0Smp4QmVlaGNzWmE4blNoXzE3NTg1MjM5NTU6MTc1ODUyNzU1NV9WNA"][/img][/p][p]As missions progress, you will lead Griffin Squad into the core of the Primal Death Ring, where the \[Zero Catalyst] holds the key to the truth behind the Death Ring. Defend scientists, investigate the Catalyst, and face an unknown yet powerful enemy.[/p][h3]New Paint System[/h3][p]Thanks to earlier investigations and breakthroughs in material science, Mecha customization is now possible. Commanders can use the new paint system in the hangar to design unique looks for their mecha. We will continue improving this feature based on your feedback—share your thoughts on the Discussion Board and our social channels![/p][p][img src="https://t18q1u0b4vq.feishu.cn/space/api/box/stream/download/asynccode/?code=ZTc0NzA2NjFlODIxYzI4MDNiYTYwZjU2YzE1MGZlMGZfRnFpSUlXRlpPOEVUN2Rmb0ltbHZtazg5ZVFOVUx6bmxfVG9rZW46UkxKb2JLMGhzb3hXbUp4cjlubWNJd1h3bjFoXzE3NTg1MjM5NTU6MTc1ODUyNzU1NV9WNA"][/img][/p][h3]New Loadouts and Modules[/h3][olist][*][p][b]New Loadouts[/b][/p][olist][*][p]"Freeze" Ray Emitter[/p][/*][*][p]"FL-27" Heavy Laser Autocannon[/p][/*][*][p]"Fubuki" Cryo Sniper Rifle[/p][/*][*][p]"Hyoba" Condensing Pulse Autocannon[/p][/*][*][p]Arashi Cryogenic Deployment System[/p][/*][/olist][/*][*][p][b]New Modules:[/b][/p][olist][*][p]M211 At the start of the turn, for every 10 stacks of Cryo, Coolant Capacity +1, lasting until the end of the turn.[/p][/*][*][p]M212 Once per battle, when Frozen, remove Frozen and all Cryo stacks.[/p][/*][*][p]M213 For every 10 Energy consumed, Cryo stacks -1.[/p][/*][*][p]M214 Each time Mobility becomes 0, own Cryo stacks +5 and Melee +10%, lasting until the end of battle.[/p][/*][*][p]M215 For each stack of Cryo owned, Critical Damage +2%.[/p][/*][*][p]M216 For every 10 stacks of Cryo gained, Mechanics +3%, lasting until the end of battle.[/p][/*][*][p]M217 When gaining Cryo stacks, for each stack gained, Critical Chance +1%, lasting until the end of the turn.[/p][/*][*][p]M218 When attacking enemies under the Cryo state, Particle +10%, lasting until the attack ends. If the enemy is killed, retain the bonus until the end of battle.[/p][/*][*][p]M219 When attacking enemies under the Frozen state, Critical Chance +20%.[/p][/*][*][p]M220 When applying Cryo to a Frozen enemy, enemies within 1 tile gain 10 stacks of Cryo.[/p][/*][*][p]M221 For each Frozen enemy affected by Electric Bounce, Bounce Efficiency +1, lasting until the end of the turn.[/p][/*][*][p]M222 If an attack with Cryo affects critics, it has a 10% chance to directly apply Frozen.[/p][/*][*][p]M223 When killing a Frozen enemy, 50% chance to apply Frozen to a random enemy within 2 tiles.[/p][/*][*][p]M224 When applying Cryo to an enemy already under the Cryo state, apply an additional stack of Cryo.[/p][/*][*][p]M225 For each enemy Frozen, Recruitment Points +10.[/p][/*][/olist][/*][/olist][h3]Other Updates[/h3][list][*][p]"Taran" Railgun: Model overhaul, skill redesigned.[/p][/*][*][p]"Red Fang" Dual Heavy Axe Combo: Damage source adjusted from "Particle + Mechanical" to "Particle + Melee".[/p][/*][*][p]Tutorial stage adjusted—shortened by one in-game day[/p][/*][*][p]The initial weapon of Mercury in Chapter I has been changed from "Freeze" Heavy Sword to "L4" LMG Combo.[/p][/*][*][p]Added hotkeys for selecting Mechas and skills during battle.[/p][/*][*][p]Modified the hotkey for selecting Mechas in the hangar.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized scroll wheel experience in all UI lists.[/p][/*][*][p]Opening the guide manual now disables scene camera controls.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where some battle event details did not show monster previews.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where module tags were difficult to see in English.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where some UI text overflowed in English.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an incorrect subtitle issue in the settings menu.[/p][/*][/list][p]If you encounter any issues after updating, please reach us on the Steam Discussion Board or our official community platforms![/p]

notes.title: Version Update Notice V0.5.0｜0826
notes.notes: [p]It has been over a month since [i]Death Ring: Second Impact[/i] entered Early Access, and we sincerely appreciate all your support! We are currently working at full speed on a brand-new chapter and new features, which we plan to bring to you next month. Without further ado, here is the update content:[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Key Updates[/b][/h3][olist][*][p][b]Pool Dilution Issue Resolved[/b] Since the launch of the EA version, we have received extensive feedback regarding the Recruit Pack unlocking logic. We understand that pool dilution has impacted your tactical experience, so we’ve reworked the system:[/p][olist][*][p]The previous module and loadout disabling system has been unified into a Recruit Pack enable/disable system.[/p][/*][*][p]At least 12 Recruit Packs must remain enabled to start a mission.[/p][/*][*][p]Existing packs have been partially adjusted to fit this new logic.[/p][/*][/olist][/*][*][p][b]New Save Points[/b][/p][olist][*][p]Exiting during the preparation phase or returning to the main menu now saves your Hangar configuration.[/p][/*][*][p]A save is created when you click “Next Day” . During battle, if you quit or fail, selecting \[Return to Previous Day] will load this save.[/p][/*][/olist][/*][/olist][h3]New Content[/h3][olist][*][p][b]New Loadouts[/b][/p][olist][*][p]"Helstorm" Heavy Rotary Cannon[/p][/*][*][p]"Red Fang" Dual Heavy Axe Combo[/p][/*][*][p]"Cinder & Red Fang" Gun & Axe Combo[/p][/*][*][p]"Cinder & Iron Wall" Gun & Shield Combo[/p][/*][*][p]"Red Fang & Iron Wall" Axe & Shield Combo[/p][/*][/olist][/*][*][p][b]New Modules[/b][/p][olist][*][p][b]M183[/b]: Each constructed engineering unit gains 10 Core Durability every time it deals an instance of damage, lasting until the end of the battle.[/p][/*][*][p][b]M184[/b]: When a constructed engineering unit is attacked, it inflicts 10 Rupture stacks on the attacker.[/p][/*][*][p][b]M185[/b]: At the start of the turn, a constructed engineering unit gains 10 Core Durability for each adjacent engineering unit, lasting until the end of the battle.[/p][/*][*][p][b]M186[/b]: At the start of the turn, a constructed engineering unit gains 5% Mechanics for each adjacent engineering unit, lasting until the end of the battle.[/p][/*][*][p][b]M187[/b]: At the start of the turn, if no units are adjacent to a constructed engineering unit, it gains Core Durability +100, Critical Chance +10%, and Critical Damage +20%, lasting until the end of the battle.[/p][/*][*][p][b]M188[/b]: When constructing an engineering unit, its Mechanics +100%, lasting for 1 turn.[/p][/*][*][p][b]M189[/b]: When a constructed engineering unit attacks, randomly inflict either 10 Rupture stacks or 10 Overheat stacks on the target enemy.[/p][/*][*][p][b]M190[/b]: For every 2 Energizing stacks consumed, Mobility +1, lasting until the end of the turn.[/p][/*][*][p][b]M191[/b]: For every 1 Energizing stack consumed, restore 5 Energy next turn.[/p][/*][*][p][b]M192[/b]: For each enemy in Overheat state that dies during the enemy turn, Particle +10%, lasting until the end of the battle.[/p][/*][*][p][b]M193[/b]: When using an attack that applies Electric Bounce, if there is only 1 target, Particle +50%, lasting until the end of the attack.[/p][/*][*][p][b]M194[/b]: For every 20 Paralysis effects inflicted on enemies, Bounce Efficiency +1, lasting until the end of the battle.[/p][/*][*][p][b]M195[/b]: When using a Rupture-inflicting attack, after the attack ends, trigger Rupture Damage on the target.[/p][/*][*][p][b]M196[/b]: When attacking, for each Overheat stack owned, Firepower +1%, lasting until the end of the attack.[/p][/*][*][p][b]M197[/b]: When using a Repair-type skill, restore Core Durability equal to 50% of the redtoring amount to the allied Mecha with the lowest Core Durability on the field.[/p][/*][*][p][b]M198[/b]: Each time a constructed engineering unit attacks an enemy, Recruitment Points +1.[/p][/*][*][p][b]M199[/b]: Every second attack costs 20 Recruitment Points. But if it kills an enemy, gain 50 Recruitment Points.[/p][/*][*][p][b]M200[/b]: For each damage instance exceeding 10,000 damage, gain Recruitment Points equal to 1% of that damage amount.[/p][/*][*][p][b]M201[/b]: Throw-type skills are also treated as Melee-type skills.[/p][/*][*][p][b]M202[/b]: Critical Chance -100%, gain Mechanics bonus equal to 5% of Core Durability maximum.[/p][/*][*][p][b]M203[/b]: At the start of the turn, for each enemy within 3 tiles, Melee +10%, lasting until the end of the turn.[/p][/*][*][p][b]M204[/b]: When using a Melee-type skill, deal additional damage equal to half the original damage to all units surrounding the target enemy.[/p][/*][*][p][b]M205[/b]: When using a Ranged-type skill, for each damage instance dealt, Firepower +1%, lasting until the end of the turn.[/p][/*][*][p][b]M206[/b]: When Core Durability first drops below 30% of Core Durability maximum, restore all Armor Durability.[/p][/*][*][p][b]M207[/b]: Each time Armor Durability is restored or increased, accumulate extra damage for the next attack equal to 50% of the restored amount; can stack.[/p][/*][*][p][b]M208[/b]: At the end of the turn, for each remaining point of Magazine Capacity, Firepower +10%, lasting until the end of the battle.[/p][/*][*][p][b]M209[/b]: For each Stun inflicted on an enemy, Damage Modifier +5%, lasting until the end of the battle.[/p][/*][*][p][b]M210[/b]: When attacking, for each target, Damage Modifier +5%, lasting until the end of the attack.[/p][/*][*][p]  [/p][/*][/olist][/*][/olist][h3]Content Optimization[/h3][olist][*][p][b]Heavy Armor Adjustments[/b][/p][olist][*][p]Now provides fixed damage reduction based on Mechanics value.[/p][/*][*][p]Enemies carrying Heavy Armor now also have base Mechanics.[/p][/*][/olist][/*][*][p][b]Visual Improvements for Some Loadouts[/b][/p][olist][*][p]Reactive Pauldron[/p][/*][*][p]"Revenge" Propulsion System[/p][/*][*][p]"T12" Propulsion Device[/p][/*][*][p]"Darius" Engineering Backpack[/p][/*][/olist][/*][*][p][b]Hangar Rendering Optimization[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Localization Text Adjustments[/b][/p][/*][/olist][hr][/hr][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][olist][*][p]Fixed an issue where abnormal enemy AI logic could cause freezes.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed blurry HP bar issue of Corrocodile.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed abnormal HP bar issue of BlackSamurai.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed tutorial text display errors.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed abnormal outline display of BlackSamurai when as an enemy.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where specific buildings in Rust City could not be destroyed.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed abnormal building state after loading a save in specific conditions.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed texture errors on "Freeze" Heavy Sword, "Thunderbolt" Laser Guidance System, "HotSand" Heavy Shotgun, and Spiked Pauldron.[/p][/*][/olist][hr][/hr][h3]Balance Adjustments[/h3][olist][*][p][b]M6[/b]: Critical Chance is fixed at 80%, and Critical Damage cap is fixed at [u]200%[/u].[/p][olist][*][p]adjusted to 150%.[/p][/*][/olist][/*][*][p][b]M22[/b]: When current Core Durability is below [u]30%[/u] of its maximum, deal Core Damage.[/p][olist][*][p]adjusted to 20%.[/p][/*][/olist][/*][*][p][b]M32[/b]: The first 2 Energy consumptions each turn cost 0 Energy.[/p][olist][*][p]adjusted from 3 tiles to 4 tiles.[/p][/*][/olist][/*][*][p][b]M33[/b]: For each enemy killed, restore 5 Energy.[/p][olist][*][p]adjusted from 4 tiles to 3 tiles.[/p][/*][/olist][/*][*][p][b]M102[/b]: For each damage instance dealt to an enemy, Melee +2%, lasting until the end of the battle.[/p][olist][*][p]adjusted from “Enhanced” to “Experimental”.[/p][/*][/olist][/*][*][p][b]Enemy Adjustments[/b]: Attack coefficient of Tail Larvae, Tail Beetle, and Destroyer increased by 0.2.[/p][/*][/olist][hr][/hr][p]If you encounter any issues after the update, please contact us via the Discussion Board or community platforms.[/p][p]We will continue collecting feedback and further optimizing.[/p][p]Thank you again for your support and trust, Commander![/p]

notes.title: V0.5.0 Upcoming Update Announcement | 0819
notes.notes: [p]Commander, Version V0.5.0 will be released on August 26. This update introduces adjustments to the save system and the new Recruit Pack Ban feature. As a result, your current battle progress will not be preserved.[/p][p]Rest assured—your Omni-Matter, Catalyst Zero, unlocked Recruit Packs, and Chapter progress will remain intact. Please try to complete any ongoing battles before the update.[/p][p][b]Known Update Content[/b][/p][olist][*][p]New Recruit Pack Ban Feature: Choose from your unlocked Recruit Packs at the start of battle.[/p][/*][*][p]Additional Auto-Save Points: Progress will now be saved automatically when manually exiting during the daily maintenance phase and at the end of each in-game day.[/p][/*][*][p]New Recruit Packs Added: The Siberia Manufacturing Group has brought us some mysterious new equipment.[/p][/*][/olist][p]If you encounter any issues, feel free to contact us via the Steam Discussion Board or our official community channels![/p]

notes.title: Version Update Notice V0.4.6 | 0724
notes.notes: [p]Hi Commander![/p][p]Here are the key updates in Patch V0.4.6:[/p][hr][/hr][h3]New Features & Optimizations[/h3][p][b]New System:[/b][/p][olist][*][p]Tutorial Review Panel[/p][/*][*][p]Term Explanation Panel[/p][/*][*][p]Map Mechanics Panel[/p][/*][/olist][p]These panels can be accessed anytime during both Combat and Preparation phases.[/p][p][b]New Feature:[/b][/p][p]When there are 10 or fewer enemies on the field, activating a skill will now highlight the outlines of all remaining enemies.[/p][p][b]Art Upgrade for certain Loadouts:[/b][/p][olist][*][p]"Mjolnir" HMG[/p][/*][*][p]"Adur Gushnasp" Incendiary Missile[/p][/*][/olist][hr][/hr][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][olist][*][p]Adjusted the stacking rules for the Rupture Efficiency on Module M12.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Module M81's counter and effects were not working correctly in combat.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where deleting save data in Settings did not also delete its associated Heat Preset.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an exploit allowing infinite Energy Skill usage by combining the \[Transform] skill and Module M151:[/p][list][*][p]\[Transform] no longer costs any resources, preventing it from triggering Module M151's Energy consumption counter.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in Heat Mode where Mecha destroyed in the previous battle would result in an immediately destroyed upon next deployment due to no automatic Core Durability recovery:[/p][list][*][p]Mecha now retains 1 Core Durability when returning to the Hangar after being destroyed in the battle.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Fixed several freeze issues related to friendly fire.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized performance in certain scenarios.[/p][/*][/olist][hr][/hr][p]We've heard your significant feedback on topics like pool dilution, save issues, and other feedback. notes.title: Demo Update Announcement
notes.notes: [p]Since the release of our Demo in February, we've received an overwhelming amount of feedback. To review and implement these suggestions, we have invested far more time and effort than expected, but we truly believe it was all worth it.[/p][p]Here are some of the major changes we've made during this time:[/p][olist][*][p][b]Complete overhaul of the stat system[/b]: We've restructured the core attribute types into four categories: Combat, Firepower, Mechanics, and Particle. This change will make them more intuitive and easier to understand. Armor and damage types have also been reworked, allowing armor to have unified structures while supporting a variety of special effects.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Loadout system adjustments[/b]: We’ve merged the left hand and right hand weapon slots into a single slot. Don’t worry, all your favorite weapon combinations are still available, with new skill sets![/p][/*][*][p][b]New module panel system[/b]: Introducing a brand new resource: [i]Almond Water[/i]! Use it to upgrade your module panel and select unique passive traits.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Audio system rework[/b]: From music to SFX, the entire audio experience has been revamped. Remember to put your headphone on![/p][/*][*][p][b]UI visual updates[/b]: The UI has been refined and will continue to be iterated on throughout Early Access.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Twin Tracks, A new introductory chapter[/b]: A new tutorial to help players quickly grasp the core gameplay mechanics.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Art upgrades[/b]: Including visual improvements for Rust City environments, existing loadouts, and mechs.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Logistics system[/b]: This new system allows you to unlock and manage loadouts and modules within the game.[/p][/*][/olist][p]A large portion of these improvements will be included as a [b]free update[/b] to the Demo. Welcome to try them out in advance! The full new systems, HEAT mode, new loadouts/modules and Chapter 2: [b]Belhaven[/b] will officially launch in the [b]Early Access version on July 11[/b].[/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]Important: For players who already own the Demo:[/b][/h3][p]The Demo will be updated alongside the Early Access release on July 11. At that time, your saved [b]stage completion progress[/b] and [b]out-of-combat data[/b] will be preserved, but any [b]ongoing battle progress will not be retained[/b].[/p][p]When you purchase the Early Access version, your saved stage progress and out-of-combat data from the Demo will automatically carry over.[/p][p]For example, if you’ve completed [b]Rust City[/b] in the Demo, you’ll continue from that point in the Early Access version, you can head straight into [b]Belhaven[/b] or re-challenge [b]Rust City[/b] with or without Heat Mode.[/p][p]However, if your save is still mid-battle in Rust City and not yet completed, that mission will be reset upon updating the Demo or purchasing Early Access, and you’ll need to replay it from the start.[/p]

notes.title: Patch V0.8.2.25 for Demo
notes.notes:
Good day Commander! Here are a few things we have been working on since Demo release:

[h3]New Feature:[/h3]
1. Added new languages: Traditional Chinese and Japanese.
2. Added map edge indicators.
3. Added daily-changing transition effects.
4. Added temporary process guidance.

[h3]Optimizations:[/h3]
1. Visual improvements: The following indicators now display grids:
  - Deployment range indicator
  - Attack range indicator
  - Movement range indicator
  - Enemy threat range indicator
2. Optimized enemy turn movement logic and camera logic.
3. Improved UI display accuracy.
4. Fixed an issue where guide videos did not play on certain devices.
5. Other 121 optimizations and 153 bug fixes.

[h3]Known Issues:[/h3]
1. Sound system: A complete overhaul is planned.
2. Loading system: The loading system will be adjusted to increase progression and guidance while maintaining freedom.
3. Character art and events: Some character art and event logic will be adjusted, and writing style will also be optimized.
4. Guidance system: A comprehensive adjustment or overhaul of the guidance system is planned.
5. DX12-related stuttering issues: Reducing graphics quality can alleviate this problem.
6. Abnormal kill count issues caused by certain components.
7. Localization Improvements: We’ve invited a professional localization team to enhance the accuracy and quality of our translations.

[i]Tip: Loadout of the day is "HotSand" Heavy Shotgun, rumored to deliver 60,000 damage in a single shot. Give it a try![/i]
